query:
-- 1. Excluir bookings de teste (por client_email)
DELETE FROM bookings 
WHERE LOWER(client_email) LIKE '%teste%' OR LOWER(client_email) LIKE '%test%'
   OR LOWER(client_name) LIKE '%teste%' OR LOWER(client_name) LIKE '%test%';

-- 2. Excluir funcionários de teste
DELETE FROM employees 
WHERE LOWER(name) LIKE '%teste%' OR LOWER(name) LIKE '%test%';

-- 3. Excluir usuários de teste
DELETE FROM users 
WHERE LOWER(name) LIKE '%teste%' OR LOWER(name) LIKE '%test%'
   OR LOWER(email) LIKE '%teste%' OR LOWER(email) LIKE '%test%';

-- 4. Excluir clientes de teste (sem dependências)
DELETE FROM allowed_clients 
WHERE LOWER(name) LIKE '%teste%' OR LOWER(name) LIKE '%test%' 
   OR LOWER(email) LIKE '%teste%' OR LOWER(email) LIKE '%test%'
   OR LOWER(name) = 'new client';
